tool_args.rationale: All five pilot responses are positive at H ≤ 0.48, while the target horizon is H = 23.2. The slow-horizon probe near H = 20 tests whether adaptation reverses the response and constrains its magnitude near the forecast horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows primarily constrain the ratio of adaptation amplitude to slow time constant, not the two parameters separately. A good pilot fit could still extrapolate poorly.
Finer trajectory sampling is less directly informative about the slow adaptation term near the forecast horizon.
